fusions.name: Herder's Sling
fusions.desc: Slings a stone at the target, dealing 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Close Shear
fusions.desc: Shears across the target with a horn for 28 damage, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Loose Fleece
fusions.desc: Shakes out your fleece, raising your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Woven Bell Collar
fusions.desc: Conjures a woven bell collar: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, each kill returns 2 health, and your maximum health rises by 10.
